prompt:
full-body portrait card, character centered, soft diffuse cool light, soft even lighting. subject: Léthé, the spirit of the river of forgetting, a tall serene dreamy woman whose long hair and flowing grey-blue robe dissolve downward into drifting pale mist and slow ribbons of water, half-closed sleepy eyes and a faint absent smile, a crown of red poppies, holding a shallow silver bowl of still water in both hands, her lower body fading into a soft river of fog, small red poppies floating in the mist, calm and hypnotic, (scenery:-3) (cast shadow:-2), isolated on a flat plain white background.

Style: a painterly young-adult fantasy novel cover illustration with clean confident linework, soft cel shading with rich painted light, appealing slightly stylised proportions and expressive faces, in a sun-bleached Mediterranean palette of marble white, warm terracotta, olive green and deep Aegean blue with small burnished gold accents; dramatic but never gory or horrific, adventurous and a little theatrical, the feel of a Greek-mythology adventure book for teenagers.
